generator: zerocoin/tests/export_baseline_vectors.rs, `p41_*` functions, added by the P4.1A commit that lands immediately after the baseline; a fixture cannot truthfully record the hash of the commit that contains it, so `source_commit` names the code and this field names the exporter separately
note: The claimed-root comparison (B-14): the root a block's transactions compute against the root its header claims, with the verdict `Block::validate_structure` itself returned. Each case publishes the header, the exact serialized transactions, the validator context, both digests in internal and display form, the leaf ids, and whether the header's proof of work meets its own target.
provenance: every verdict was produced by a direct call to the shipping `zerocoin/` Rust function `consensus::block::Block::validate_structure` at `source_commit`, which is where rule B-14 lives; every computed root by `Block::compute_merkle_root` on that call's own transaction list, every leaf id by `Transaction::txid`, and every header nonce by `consensus::pow::mine`. No claim, root or verdict here is taken from another implementation, computed by hand, or re-derived by this exporter
